description: Installation of a 20-metre monopole, 12 antennae apertures, equipment cabinets, together with the removal of the existing 13.7 metre monopole, 3 no. antennae, redundant equipment cabinets and development ancillary thereto
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( MBNL - 5G and Future Technology - Delivering the UK's Teleocoms Future; Unnumbered DCMS/MHCLG Practice Note for Collaborating for Digital Connectivity dated 7th March 2019; DCMS Connective Growth Manual; Unnumbered Planning Statement; Unnumbered 5G and Health Q&A dated May 2019; Unnumbered Councils and Connectivity Dated September 2018; Unnumbered Declaration of Conformity with ICNIRP Public Exposure Guidelines dated 27/09/2019; 002 Site Location Plan; 100 Existing Site Plan; 150 Existing Elevation A; 215 Max Configuration Site Plan; 265 Max Configuration Elevation. Received: 04/10/2019 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Within 28 calendar days of the date of the apparatus hereby approved coming into use, the date of which shall be notified in writing to the Local Planning Authority no less than 14 calendar days prior, the existing apparatus shall be dismantled and removed from the site, including all associated debris.
